item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-05-31
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 今天 Nervos Talk 社区整体较平静，主要活动集中在 Spark Program 资助提案的推进上 [S01, S02]。Cell Sandbox 项目作者根据反馈完成了修订，委员会将在下周会议后给出评审结果 [S01, S02]。此外，一位从以太坊转向 CKB 的开发者分享了学习 Cell 模型的体验 [S03]。 ## 重点话题 **Cell Sandbox 提案修订完成**：作者 zynor 针对评审反馈进行了修改，新增了与现有 CCC 工具（live.ckbccc.com 和 app.ckbccc.com）的差异化说明，明确了两者的定位区别 [S01]。 **资助评审进入下一阶段**：Spark Program 委员会成员 zz_tovarishch 确认，将在下周会议后给出该提案的评审结果，目前处于等待状态 [S02]。 **跨链开发者学习体验分享**：开发者 jm9k 从以太坊转向 CKB 的经历被提及，表示从 EVM 到 Cell 模型的概念转换存在难度，早期缺乏框架也增加了学习门槛 [S03]。 ## 值得继续跟进 **Cell Sandbox 评审结果**：下周委员会会议后的最终决定，将决定该可视化 Cell 模型工具能否获得资助 [S02]。 **新开发者 onboarding 体验**：jm9k 提到的"早期缺乏框架"问题是否已改善，以及当前新开发者的学习路径是否足够友好，值得观察 [S03]。

item.title: Spark Program | Cell Sandbox — A Visual Playground for the CKB Cell Model (2 posts)
item.description: Hi , Thanks for the thoughtful review. I’ve revised the proposal based on your feedback. CCC is code-first and task-first; Cell Sandbox is design-first. item.title: CKB probably isn’t the first chain most people learn, but it might be the first one that makes them rethink what a blockchain is for (1 posts)
item.description: I came from Ethereum. The shift from EVM to the Cell Model was difficult because it’s conceptually completely different. I had some experience with Bitcoin Script, but it’s really quite different since it’s so limited. When I started there were also no frameworks available, and no production ready examples of any kind. Nearly every developer that attempted to learn back then became frustrated and left. It’s much better today, but there is always much to improve on.
